src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/GeneralInvento.name: Inventory addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/GeneralInvento.description: Manages feed and supply items: add and edit them, record purchases, feed use and stock corrections, and view their history.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/GeneralInvento.name: Water usage addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/GeneralInvento.description: Records, corrects and lists the water the farm uses.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Audit.name: Activity log address
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Audit.description: Gives a read-only view of who did what on the farm.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Expor.name: Spreadsheet file writer
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Expor.description: Turns farm data into spreadsheet files that open correctly in Excel.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Expor.name: Data export addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Expor.description: Lets an admin download the farm's data as a manual backup, all at once or one dataset at a time.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Insig.name: Reports feature registration
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Insig.description: Switches on the reports, activity log and export features when the server starts.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Repor.name: Report overload limit
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Repor.description: Limits how many reports one farm can run at once, answering with a try-again-later message beyond that.

src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Repor.name: Report addresses
src/Cluckwork.Api/Modules/Insights/Repor.description: Produces the production, sales, expense and profit reports; production is open to all, money reports to admins.

GET /api/v1/inventory/items.name: List inventory items
GET /api/v1/inventory/items.description: Shows feed and supply items with current stock.

POST /api/v1/inventory/items.name: Add inventory item
POST /api/v1/inventory/items.description: Adds a new feed or supply item; admin only.

POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/d.name: Deactivate item
POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/d.description: Hides an item that is no longer used.

POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/a.name: Activate item
POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/a.description: Brings a hidden item back into use.

POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/p.name: Record purchase
POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/p.description: Records a purchase that adds stock of an item.

GET /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/lo.name: List item batches
GET /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/lo.description: Shows the purchase batches making up an item's stock.

GET /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/mo.name: List item movements
GET /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/mo.description: Shows every stock change for an item.

POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/u.name: Record feed use
POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/u.description: Records feed used by a flock, which lowers stock.

POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/a.name: Correct stock
POST /api/v1/inventory/items/{id:guid}/a.description: Fixes an item's stock count; admin only.

POST /api/v1/water-usage.name: Record water use
POST /api/v1/water-usage.description: Records water used on a day.

PUT /api/v1/water-usage/{id:guid}.name: Correct water use
PUT /api/v1/water-usage/{id:guid}.description: Fixes a recorded water use; admin only.

GET /api/v1/audit.name: List activity log
GET /api/v1/audit.description: Shows the log of who did what and when.

GET /api/v1/export/all.name: Export everything
GET /api/v1/export/all.description: Downloads all of the farm's data in one backup.

GET /api/v1/export/{dataset}.name: Export one dataset
GET /api/v1/export/{dataset}.description: Downloads one kind of data, such as sales, as a spreadsheet file.

GET /api/v1/reports/production.name: Production report
GET /api/v1/reports/production.description: Shows egg production over a period; open to every signed-in user.

GET /api/v1/reports/sales.name: Sales report
GET /api/v1/reports/sales.description: Summarizes sales over a period; admin only.

GET /api/v1/reports/expenses.name: Expense report
GET /api/v1/reports/expenses.description: Summarizes spending over a period; admin only.

GET /api/v1/reports/profit.name: Profit report
GET /api/v1/reports/profit.description: Compares sales against spending over a period; admin only.
